description: Find hotels similar to a given hotel. Use this for branching exploration after a search (e.g. user likes the Park Hyatt Tokyo but wants a cheaper alternative — find similar properties). Pass destination when the alternatives should be in a different city. Returns properties matched by hotel attributes and amenities, with current rates.

destination.description: Optional destination city or place for cross-city alternatives.

hotel_id.description: The seed hotel's Vervotech property ID.

name: get_similar_hotels
